name: ClusterFormationStarted
description: Fires the first time verifyNeo4jClusterFormation finds the cluster not yet formed, as status.phase transitions into Forming.

name: ClusterFormationFailed
description: Fires when the SHOW SERVERS / split-brain check used to verify cluster formation itself errors, distinct from the cluster simply not being formed yet.

name: ClusterReady
description: Fires once per Ready transition, when updateClusterStatusWithVersion actually changes status.phase to Ready after formation and full StatefulSet rollout are both verified.

name: TopologyWarning
description: Fires for each non-fatal warning returned by the spec validator's ValidateCreateWithWarnings/ValidateUpdateWithWarnings during Reconcile.

name: ValidationFailed
description: Fires when an inline spec validator (cluster, standalone, database, alias, sharded database, replica, backup, restore, user, role, etc.) rejects the CR's spec with hard errors; reconciliation halts until the spec is fixed.

name: TopologyPlacementFailed
description: Fires when CalculateTopologyPlacement errors, e.g. enforceDistribution requested with fewer discoverable availability zones than servers.

name: TopologyPlacementCalculated
description: Fires after a successful topology placement calculation that found at least one availability zone to spread servers across.

name: TopologyZoneDiscoveryDegraded
description: Fires when cluster-scoped Node listing for AZ auto-discovery fails (typically a namespace-scoped install lacking node RBAC) but zone-based spread/anti-affinity is still applied via the topology label key.

name: PropertyShardingValidationFailed
description: Fires when spec.propertySharding is enabled but fails version, cluster-size, required-config-key, or resource-minimum validation.

name: ServerRoleValidationFailed
description: Fires when ValidateServerRoleHints rejects spec.topology.serverRoles, e.g. an out-of-range serverIndex, a duplicate index, or every server set to SECONDARY.

name: StorageClassNotFound
description: Fires when spec.storage.className names a StorageClass that doesn't exist, before any StatefulSet is created — otherwise the pod would stay Pending indefinitely with no signal.

name: RouteAPINotFound
description: Fires when an OpenShift Route (or MCP Route) is configured but route.openshift.io/v1 isn't registered in the cluster, so Route reconciliation is skipped.

name: MCPApocMissing
description: Fires when spec.mcp.enabled is true but no enabled Neo4jPlugin named apoc/apoc-extended targets this cluster or standalone, since MCP stdio mode needs APOC procedures.

name: ReconcileFailed
description: Fires when a controller's inner reconcile helper chain (TLS/ConfigMap/Service/StatefulSet for standalone; create/drop/status-refresh for a Neo4jShardedDatabase) returns an error, before status is set to Failed.

name: UpgradeStarted
description: Fires when a rolling upgrade's pre-flight gates (version compatibility, StatefulSet readiness, pre-upgrade health) pass and the state machine transitions into Staging (cluster), or when the standalone begins its own pre-upgrade check on image-tag drift.

name: UpgradeCompleted
description: Fires when stepUpgradeVerifying confirms every server reports the target version and the Completed phase is persisted.

name: UpgradePaused
description: Fires when a rolling-upgrade step fails and upgradeStrategy.autoPauseOnFailure is set, halting the state machine for manual intervention.

name: UpgradeFailed
description: Fires when a rolling-upgrade step's deadline or gate is exceeded without autoPauseOnFailure set, or when the standalone's pre-upgrade health check fails with autoPauseOnFailure set.

name: UpgradeDeferred
description: Fires when a rolling upgrade is deferred because a scale-down drain is still in progress (mutual exclusion — the drain must finish first).

name: ScaleDownBlocked
description: Fires when a scale-down cannot proceed: below the system database's minimum voting-member floor, a DEALLOCATE dry-run fails, or a DROP SERVER fails — replicas stay held at the current count.

name: ScaleDownDraining
description: Fires on each successful drain step (cordon, deallocate, or drop) as the scale-down worker walks servers being removed by a topology shrink toward zero.

name: StorageExpansionStarted
description: Fires when a PVC size comparison finds at least one PVC smaller than spec.storage.size, before any PVC is patched.

name: StorageExpansionCompleted
description: Fires after every undersized PVC has been patched to the new size and the owning StatefulSet orphan-deleted for recreation with updated VolumeClaimTemplates.

name: StorageExpansionFailed
description: Fires when a storage shrink is rejected, the StorageClass doesn't allow expansion, or patching a PVC / orphan-deleting the StatefulSet itself errors.

name: ConnectivityDegraded
description: Fires once per outage streak, at the 10th consecutive reconcile that fails to reach Neo4j over Bolt, so a persistent outage is distinguishable from a transient rolling-restart blip.

name: SplitBrainDetected
description: Fires when per-pod SHOW SERVERS views diverge into more than one cluster group and at least one minority pod sees servers outside the majority's view.

name: SplitBrainRepaired
description: Fires after the orphaned pods identified by split-brain analysis have been deleted for the StatefulSet to recreate and rejoin the majority.

name: SplitBrainRepairFailed
description: Fires when deleting an orphaned pod during automatic split-brain repair itself errors.

name: AuraFleetManagementFailed
description: Fires when Phase 2 Aura Fleet Management token registration fails (Secret unreadable, plugin not yet loaded, registerToken errors) — the cluster/standalone itself remains operational.

name: AuraFleetManagementPluginPatchFailed
description: Fires when the live StatefulSet patch that merges fleet-management into NEO4J_PLUGINS fails.

name: AuraFleetManagementRegistered
description: Fires once fleetManagement.registerToken succeeds against a Ready cluster or standalone instance.

name: ValidationWarning
description: An inline spec validator (DatabaseValidator, AliasValidator, ReplicaValidator, etc.) surfaced a non-fatal warning; reconciliation continues.

name: ClusterNotFound
description: The CR's clusterRef/instanceRef did not resolve to any Neo4jEnterpriseCluster or Neo4jEnterpriseStandalone in the namespace.

name: ClusterNotReady
description: The referenced cluster was found but is not yet Ready (or, for sharded databases, not yet property-sharding-operational).

name: ConnectionFailed
description: The operator could not open a Bolt client connection to the resolved cluster/standalone target.

name: CreationFailed
description: The CREATE DATABASE Cypher call for a Neo4jDatabase failed.

name: DataImportFailed
description: One of spec.initialData.cypherStatements failed to execute against the newly created database.

name: DataImported
description: spec.initialData's Cypher statements executed successfully; status.dataImported is marked true.

name: DataSeeded
description: A database created from spec.seedURI is marked as having its data sourced from the seed rather than initialData.

name: DatabaseReady
description: The Neo4jDatabase reconcile completed successfully and the Ready condition/status.phase is set to Ready.

name: DatabaseCreatedFromSeed
description: CREATE DATABASE with a seedURI/seedURIs OPTIONS clause (with or without an explicit topology) succeeded.

name: DeletionFailed
description: DROP DATABASE failed during Neo4jDatabase finalizer cleanup; the finalizer is retried or released depending on the error class.

name: DatabaseDeleted
description: DROP DATABASE succeeded during Neo4jDatabase finalizer cleanup.

name: AliasCreated
description: CREATE ALIAS succeeded for a Neo4jDatabaseAlias that had no live alias yet.

name: AliasRetargeted
description: The live alias's target database drifted from spec.targetDatabase and ALTER ALIAS ... SET TARGET corrected it (spec wins).

name: AliasReady
description: The Neo4jDatabaseAlias resolves to its intended target database.

name: AliasDropped
description: DROP ALIAS succeeded during Neo4jDatabaseAlias finalizer cleanup.

name: AliasFailed
description: An alias lookup, CREATE, ALTER, or DROP Cypher call failed.

name: ClientCreationFailed
description: The operator could not construct a Neo4j Bolt client for a Neo4jShardedDatabase's referenced cluster.

name: ShardedDatabaseReady
description: The property-sharded database's graph shard reports online in SHOW DATABASES and the CR is marked Ready.

name: ShardedDatabaseDropped
description: DROP DATABASE ... DESTROY DATA succeeded ahead of a spec.replaceExisting+force destructive re-seed.

name: SeedBackupPending
description: The Neo4jShardedDatabase is waiting for its seedBackupRef's Neo4jBackup to produce a Succeeded run before it can seed.

name: SeedBackupResolutionFailed
description: Resolving seedBackupRef into concrete seed URIs failed permanently (missing Neo4jBackup CR, unsupported storage type, or missing per-shard filenames).

name: SeedProxyStarting
description: The operator-managed PVC seed-proxy Deployment fronting a PVC-backed backup is not yet Ready.

name: SeedCredsMissing
description: The target cluster/standalone lacks the cloud credentials Secret a seedURI/seedBackupRef needs, and auto-inherit is not enabled.

name: SeedCredsAutoInherited
description: The operator patched the target's spec.extraEnvFrom with the seed credentials Secret and is waiting for the resulting rolling restart.

name: ReplicaCreated
description: CreateReplicaDatabaseFromBackup succeeded, creating a new cross-cluster replica database on the Neo4jReplicaDatabase's target.

name: ReplicaReady
description: The replica database is online and actively replicating from its upstream (reported with its current transaction lag).

name: ReplicaFailed
description: A replica database lookup, create, or drop Cypher call failed.

name: ReplicaDropped
description: DROP DATABASE succeeded for a still-type=replica database during Neo4jReplicaDatabase finalizer cleanup.

name: ReplicaRetainedAfterPromotion
description: Deletion was refused because the live database's type is no longer replica (it was promoted); the finalizer is released without dropping the database.

name: ReplicaPromotionDetected
description: The Neo4jReplicaDatabase reconciler observed the live database's type flip away from replica out of band (not via this operator's own Neo4jReplicaPromotion completing on this CR).

name: ReplicaVersionTooOld
description: The target cluster's Neo4j version is below the minimum required to host a cross-cluster replica (MinCCDRReplicaVersion).

name: ReplicaPromotionStarted
description: The irreversible replica-promote call is about to be issued; the in-flight replication lag at this instant becomes permanent data loss.

name: ReplicaPromotionCompleted
description: A post-promote CHECK confirmed the live database's type is no longer replica; the promotion is recorded as terminal.

name: ReplicaPromotionFailed
description: The promotion could not proceed or be confirmed (referenced Neo4jReplicaDatabase/database missing, unreachable cluster, or a failed promote call).

name: BackupScheduled
description: A CronJob was created or updated for a Neo4jBackup CR with spec.schedule set.

name: BackupStarted
description: A one-time backup Job was created for a Neo4jBackup CR.

name: BackupCompleted
description: The backup Job reached JobComplete and its run (including artifact filenames) was recorded in status.history.

name: BackupFailed
description: The Neo4jBackup spec was invalid, or the backup Job failed terminally (BackoffLimit exhausted or startup timeout).

name: BackupRetentionCaveat
description: Warns that filename-level PVC retention pruning can orphan differential artifacts whose parent FULL backup ages out (chain-aware pruning needs neo4j-admin backup aggregate).

name: BackupShardedDatabasesExcluded
description: An all-databases backup captured property-sharded databases as per-shard artifacts (status.shardedFamilies) that its own all-databases restore path cannot recreate; each must restore via its Neo4jShardedDatabase CR.

name: ReplicationSourceCaveat
description: Published the exact directory a downstream cross-cluster replica should pull from (spec.mode=replication-source), or warned that the storage type has no cross-cluster URI form.

name: ServiceAccountAnnotationConflict
description: Two backup/restore CRs in the same namespace declared different workload-identity annotations on the shared neo4j-backup-sa/neo4j-restore-sa ServiceAccount; the last-reconciled CR's annotations win.

name: BackupValidateUnsupported
description: options.validate was requested but `neo4j-admin backup validate` doesn't exist on this Neo4j image (it requires a CalVer 2025.x+ image).

name: RestoreStarted
description: A restore Job was created, a cluster-native Cypher recreate was issued, or an all-databases per-database seed began.

name: RestoreCompleted
description: The Neo4jRestore reconcile reached its terminal Completed phase.

name: RestoreFailed
description: The restore Job, Cypher recreate/online-wait, or seed-proxy/seed-config setup failed terminally.

name: RestoreFromChainParent
description: The resolved backup run is a differential artifact that depends on a FULL backup from a chainFromBackup parent CR.

name: DatabaseCreateFailed
description: The restored database (or one of several, in an all-databases restore) could not be created/started/brought online after an otherwise-successful restore.

name: SeedEndpointNotProjected
description: The target cluster's server pods cannot reach the seed source because cloud credentials or a custom S3 endpoint could not be projected/auto-inherited onto the cluster.

name: RestoreSeedProgress
description: Periodic progress update while an all-databases restore's per-database seed is still coming online (allocation counts or the last poll's error).

name: RestoreShardedDatabasesNotCovered
description: An all-databases restore does not recreate property-sharded databases in its per-database loop; each must be restored via its own Neo4jShardedDatabase CR (spec.seedBackupRef) pointed at the same backup.

name: UserCreated
description: Emitted when CreateUserAdvanced successfully creates a new Neo4j user for a Neo4jUser CR (neo4juser_controller.go).

name: UserUpdated
description: Emitted when an ALTER USER clause set is applied (or the password already matched, treated as satisfied) for an existing Neo4jUser CR (neo4juser_controller.go).

name: UserDeleted
description: Emitted after DROP USER succeeds during Neo4jUser deletion cleanup (neo4juser_controller.go).

name: UserReady
description: Emitted the first time a Neo4jUser's granted roles fully match spec.roles with no pending dependencies (neo4juser_controller.go).

name: UserDeletionFailed
description: Emitted when DROP USER fails during Neo4jUser deletion; a retryable failure requeues, otherwise the finalizer is released to avoid wedging deletion (neo4juser_controller.go).

name: UserSyncFailed
description: Emitted on any lookup/create/alter/role-grant failure during Neo4jUser reconciliation, moving the CR to phase Failed (neo4juser_controller.go).

name: PasswordRotated
description: Emitted when the password Secret's change-detection fingerprint differs from status.passwordSecretHash, indicating a real password rotation was applied (neo4juser_controller.go).

name: RolesGranted
description: Emitted after one or more GRANT ROLE statements succeed for a Neo4jUser or Neo4jRoleBinding (neo4juser_controller.go, neo4jrolebinding_controller.go).

name: RolesRevoked
description: Emitted after one or more REVOKE ROLE statements succeed for a Neo4jUser or Neo4jRoleBinding (neo4juser_controller.go, neo4jrolebinding_controller.go).

name: RolesResolved
description: Emitted when a Neo4jRole CR's Kubernetes metadata.name in spec.roles is resolved to its effective Neo4j role name (#260 CR-name resolution) (neo4juser_controller.go, neo4jrolebinding_controller.go).

name: RolePending
description: Emitted when a desired role name matches neither a built-in nor any Neo4jRole CR, deferring the grant until the role exists (neo4juser_controller.go, neo4jrolebinding_controller.go, neo4jauthrule_controller.go).

name: RoleCreated
description: Emitted when CreateRoleAdvanced successfully creates a new Neo4j role for a Neo4jRole CR (neo4jrole_controller.go).

name: RoleDeleted
description: Emitted after DROP ROLE succeeds during Neo4jRole deletion cleanup (neo4jrole_controller.go).

name: RoleReady
description: Emitted the first time a Neo4jRole's privileges fully match spec.privileges (neo4jrole_controller.go).

name: RoleDeletionFailed
description: Emitted when DROP ROLE fails during Neo4jRole deletion; retryable failures requeue, otherwise the finalizer is released (neo4jrole_controller.go).

name: RoleSyncFailed
description: Emitted on any lookup/create/privilege-apply/revoke failure during Neo4jRole reconciliation, moving the CR to phase Failed (neo4jrole_controller.go).

name: PrivilegesApplied
description: Emitted after any GRANT/DENY or derived REVOKE privilege statements are applied to bring a role's live privileges in line with spec.privileges (neo4jrole_controller.go).

name: PrivilegesDriftKept
description: Emitted when a currently-granted privilege cannot be reconciled away — either it is immutable or no REVOKE can be textually derived — leaving PrivilegesSynced false (neo4jrole_controller.go).

name: BindingCreated
description: Emitted the first time a Neo4jRoleBinding reaches Ready with all desired roles granted to its target user (neo4jrolebinding_controller.go).

name: BindingUpdated
description: Emitted when an already-Ready Neo4jRoleBinding's granted-role set changes on a subsequent reconcile (neo4jrolebinding_controller.go).

name: BindingDeleted
description: Emitted after all previously-granted roles are revoked during Neo4jRoleBinding deletion cleanup (neo4jrolebinding_controller.go).

name: BindingFailed
description: Emitted on any lookup/grant/revoke failure during Neo4jRoleBinding reconciliation or deletion (neo4jrolebinding_controller.go).

name: UserNotFound
description: Emitted when a Neo4jRoleBinding's target username does not exist in Neo4j; bindings never create the user, only manage grants for externally provisioned users (neo4jrolebinding_controller.go).

name: AuthRuleCreated
description: Emitted when CREATE OR REPLACE AUTH RULE runs for the first time for a Neo4jAuthRule CR (neo4jauthrule_controller.go).

name: AuthRuleUpdated
description: Emitted when CREATE OR REPLACE AUTH RULE re-applies a changed condition or enabled flag for an existing Neo4jAuthRule (neo4jauthrule_controller.go).

name: AuthRuleDeleted
description: Emitted after DROP AUTH RULE succeeds during Neo4jAuthRule deletion cleanup (neo4jauthrule_controller.go).

name: AuthRuleFailed
description: Emitted on any lookup/create/grant/revoke failure during Neo4jAuthRule reconciliation (neo4jauthrule_controller.go).

name: AuthRuleVersionTooOld
description: Emitted when the target cluster's Neo4j version does not support AUTH RULE (older than 2026.03), gating the Neo4jAuthRule to phase Failed (neo4jauthrule_controller.go).

name: OIDCProviderNotConfigured
description: Emitted when the target cluster's spec.config does not set dbms.security.abac.authorization_providers, a prerequisite for ABAC auth rules (neo4jauthrule_controller.go).

name: AuraInstanceAdopted
description: Emitted when observeOrCreate matches an existing Aura instance by name and binds the CR to it instead of creating a new one.

name: AuraInstanceCreated
description: Emitted after CreateInstance (v1) or CreateInstanceV2 (multi-database) succeeds and the external-instance-id annotation has been persisted.

name: AuraInstanceUpdated
description: Emitted after reconcileDrift's PatchInstance call converges memory/storage/name/secondariesCount/cdcEnrichmentMode.

name: AuraInstancePaused
description: Emitted when reconcilePauseResume calls PauseInstance because spec.paused=true on a running instance.

name: AuraInstanceResumed
description: Emitted when reconcilePauseResume calls ResumeInstance because spec.paused=false on a paused instance.

name: AuraInstanceUpgraded
description: Emitted when reconcileUpgrade calls UpgradeInstance to move a professional-db instance to business-critical.

name: AuraInstanceDeleted
description: Emitted when handleDeletion calls DeleteInstance under deletionPolicy=Delete.

name: AuraInstanceOrphaned
description: Emitted when handleDeletion leaves the cloud instance running under the default Orphan deletionPolicy.

name: AuraInstanceFailed
description: Emitted by fail() on any reconcile failure (credentials, project ID, create, observe) and by handleDeletion when deletionProtection blocks a requested delete.

name: AuraSnapshotCreated
description: Emitted once CreateSnapshot is accepted and status.snapshotId is recorded.

name: AuraRestoreStarted
description: Emitted when RestoreSnapshot is accepted and the AuraRestore CR moves to Restoring.

name: AuraRestoreCompleted
description: Emitted when the target instance returns to Running status after a restore was issued.

name: AuraRestoreFailed
description: Emitted when the target instance enters an unexpected status during a restore, or RestoreSnapshot is rejected outright.

name: AuraDatabaseAdopted
description: Emitted when the external-database-id annotation already pinned an existing database, since v2beta1 returns no database names to match by.

name: AuraDatabaseCreated
description: Emitted after CreateDatabase succeeds; also used (as a Warning) to flag creating into an instance that already has other databases, since duplicates cannot be detected by name.

name: AuraDatabaseReady
description: Emitted every reconcile once GetDatabase succeeds and status is synced.

name: AuraDatabaseDeleted
description: Emitted when handleDeletion calls DeleteDatabase under a non-Orphan deletionPolicy.

name: AuraDatabaseOrphaned
description: Emitted when handleDeletion leaves the database in place under deletionPolicy=Orphan.

name: AuraDatabaseFailed
description: Emitted by fail() for TargetUnresolved, CreateFailed (including InstanceNotMultiDatabase) and ObserveFailed reasons.

name: AuraDatabaseBackupCreated
description: Emitted once CreateDatabaseBackup accepts the one-shot backup request.

name: AuraDatabaseBackupFailed
description: Emitted by fail() when resolving the database/target or taking the backup fails.

name: AuraDatabaseRestoreStarted
description: Emitted just before RestoreDatabase is called, after the ambiguous Submitting marker has been persisted.

name: AuraDatabaseRestoreCompleted
description: Emitted when RestoreDatabase is accepted (202); named 'Completed' in events.go but the CR phase is Submitted because v2beta1 exposes no way to observe restore completion.

name: AuraDatabaseRestoreFailed
description: Emitted by fail() when resolving the database/backup/target or the RestoreDatabase call itself fails.

name: AuraMemberNotFound
description: Emitted (Warning) when the target email is not found as an org or project member and must be invited via AuraInvite first.

name: AuraMemberRoleUpdated
description: Emitted when UpdateOrgMemberRole/UpdateProjectMemberRole changes a member's role, or AddProjectMember adds an org member to a project.

name: AuraMemberReady
description: Emitted once the member's role matches spec.role and status is synced.

name: AuraMemberRemoved
description: Emitted when handleDeletion calls DeleteOrgMember/DeleteProjectMember under deletionPolicy=Delete.

name: AuraMemberFailed
description: Emitted by fail() for CredentialsUnavailable, TargetMissing, LookupFailed, AddFailed and UpdateFailed reasons.

name: AuraInviteAdopted
description: Emitted when observeOrCreate matches an existing pending invite by email and project scope.

name: AuraInviteCreated
description: Emitted after CreateInvite succeeds with the two-slot organization/project role body.

name: AuraInviteReady
description: Emitted every reconcile once the invite's v2beta1 status has been mapped to a CR phase.

name: AuraInviteDeleted
description: Emitted when handleDeletion calls DeleteInvite under a non-Orphan deletionPolicy.

name: AuraInviteOrphaned
description: Emitted when handleDeletion leaves the invite pending under deletionPolicy=Orphan.

name: AuraInviteFailed
description: Emitted by fail() for CreateFailed/ObserveFailed and other non-refusal errors.

name: AuraCredentialsValidated
description: Emitted when the AuraProviderConfig's credentials produce a working token and a successful ListInstances call.

name: AuraCredentialsInvalid
description: Emitted (Warning) when the credential exchange or the proving ListInstances call fails.

name: AuraCustomerManagedKeyAdopted
description: Emitted when observeOrCreate matches an existing key by name and confirms it via keyId/region/cloudProvider/instanceType before adopting.

name: AuraCustomerManagedKeyCreated
description: Emitted after CreateCustomerManagedKey succeeds and the external-cmk-id annotation is persisted.

name: AuraCustomerManagedKeyReady
description: Emitted once aura.IsCMKReady(observed.Status) is true.

name: AuraCustomerManagedKeyDeleteBlocked
description: Emitted (Warning) when DeleteCustomerManagedKey is refused (400 encryption-key-is-active) because an instance still uses the key.

name: AuraCustomerManagedKeyDeleted
description: Emitted when DeleteCustomerManagedKey succeeds under deletionPolicy=Delete.

name: AuraCustomerManagedKeyOrphaned
description: Emitted when handleDeletion leaves the key registered under the default Orphan deletionPolicy.

name: AuraCustomerManagedKeyFailed
description: Emitted by fail() for CredentialsUnavailable, ProjectIDMissing, CreateFailed and ObserveFailed reasons.

name: AuraIPFilterAdopted
description: Emitted when observeOrCreate matches an existing IP filter by name.

name: AuraIPFilterCreated
description: Emitted after CreateIPFilter succeeds.

name: AuraIPFilterUpdated
description: Emitted after reconcileDrift's UpdateIPFilter call converges allow_list, filtered_entities, name or filteringDisabled.

name: AuraIPFilterReady
description: Emitted every reconcile once GetIPFilter succeeds and status is synced.

name: AuraIPFilterDeleted
description: Emitted when handleDeletion calls DeleteIPFilter under deletionPolicy=Delete.

name: AuraIPFilterOrphaned
description: Emitted when handleDeletion leaves the filter in place under deletionPolicy=Orphan.

name: AuraIPFilterFailed
description: Emitted by fail() for CredentialsUnavailable, OrganizationMissing, InstanceRefUnresolved, CreateFailed and ObserveFailed reasons.

name: PluginInstalled
description: Emitted once a Neo4jPlugin's env/init-container merge succeeds and the target's rolling restart is triggered.

name: PluginInstallFailed
description: Emitted when validating or merging a Neo4jPlugin into its target fails.

name: PluginDuplicate
description: Emitted when another Neo4jPlugin CR in the same namespace already targets the same clusterRef with the same spec.name; the newer CR (by creationTimestamp) is marked Failed rather than racing on the shared NEO4J_PLUGINS value.

name: UpstreamClusterNotFound
description: A Neo4jReplicaDatabase's source.upstreamClusterRef names a Neo4jEnterpriseCluster that does not exist (yet) in the given namespace; the replica sits Pending and retries.

name: UpstreamClusterNotReady
description: A Neo4jReplicaDatabase's source.upstreamClusterRef resolves to a real Neo4jEnterpriseCluster, but it has not yet published status.internalAddresses; the replica sits Pending and retries.

name: UpstreamBackupNotFound
description: A Neo4jReplicaDatabase's source.upstreamBackupRef names a Neo4jBackup CR that does not exist (yet) in the given namespace; the replica sits Pending and retries.

name: UpstreamBackupNotReady
description: A Neo4jReplicaDatabase's source.upstreamBackupRef resolves to a real Neo4jBackup CR, but it has not yet run a backup (status.replicationPullURI is empty); the replica sits Pending and retries.
